claim_boundary: This LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC tensor-principal theorem proves that S_AB=(alpha_B/2)partial_u Q_AB forgets a two-component u-independent tracefree corner tensor and that the minimal bulk Schouten pair is radical on a memory-inclusive carrier. It does not construct the conjugate corner momentum, angular/Coulombic Bondi recursion, boundary ghost/antifield/BFV quotient, I-/i0/I+ matching, P0/D_M charges, or any causal, particle, scattering, stability, positivity, unitarity or quantum result.

function_space_disposition.compact_support_Q: D_u is injective, but S must have zero total integral; this removes the corner mode by boundary condition rather than representing it.
function_space_disposition.memory_inclusive_Q: D_u has the u-independent tracefree kernel q_AB and retarded/advanced inverses differ by endpoint data.
function_space_disposition.retarded_only: well-defined only after declaring Q_AB^-; not equivalent to an advanced construction unless the matching condition holds

gauge_and_BFV_disposition.Weyl_ghost: delta_sigma s_AB=-alpha_B*(D_A D_B sigma)^TF at the boundary principal level
gauge_and_BFV_disposition.corner_ghost_action: OPEN; the allowed endpoint sigma and boundary diffeomorphism jets are not classified

minimal_pair_obstruction.bulk_principal_flux: omega_I_principal proportional to integral_I (delta S^AB wedge partial_u delta C_AB)
minimal_pair_obstruction.conclusion: The minimal bulk Schouten pair (Q_AB,S_AB,C_AB) is not a nondegenerate memory-inclusive boundary phase space until a two-component tracefree corner coordinate and a conjugate corner momentum/constraint are supplied.
minimal_pair_obstruction.minimal_missing_degree: one tracefree symmetric corner tensor q_AB per angle, i.e. exactly two real components before boundary gauge descent
minimal_pair_obstruction.radical: u-independent q_AB has delta S_AB=0 and is invisible to the bulk principal flux
minimal_pair_obstruction.rank_proof: For each polarization D_u on order-N jets has rank N and a one-dimensional constant kernel; adjoining q_0 gives determinant N!. Two polarizations therefore require exactly two corner coordinates.

next_gate: Add the tracefree corner coordinate and classify its conjugate momentum/constraint together with endpoint Weyl and diffeomorphism ghosts; only then retest finite-cut nondegeneracy and charges.

retarded_advanced_reconstruction.conclusion: S_AB alone determines neither endpoint source; choosing a retarded or advanced inverse is a corner condition, not an intrinsic local inverse.
retarded_advanced_reconstruction.homogeneous_ambiguity: Q_AB -> Q_AB+q_AB(x), with q_AB tracefree and u-independent

scope.boundaries: I+ retarded-time line with explicit endpoint/corner data
scope.carrier: leading p0 tracefree metric source Q_AB, leading auxiliary response S_AB, and p1 radiative response C_AB
scope.charge_sector: tracefree radiative principal Bondi jet; Coulombic aspects absent
scope.ell: local tensor principal relation; angular lower-order recursion remains open
scope.k: radial Bondi expansion, not compact momentum
scope.omega: smooth retarded-time profiles, including endpoint memory
scope.theory: linearized four-dimensional pure Weyl C^2 gravity in auxiliary-Schouten form
